title: PracticePay Patient Financing Late Fees: When One Is Charged and Booked
content:
**Scope of the late-fee schedule.** For a monthly due date whose grace period has ended with part of that monthly payment still unpaid, and only for such a due date, one late fee is charged at the amount this fee schedule sets, never more than the unpaid part of that monthly payment and never more than the plan's number of late fees per due date for that due date, with the amount of an open billing dispute left out of the unpaid part. This applies to every plan under PracticePay Patient Financing.

| Situation on the plan for a monthly due date | Late fee |
|---|---|
| grace period not yet ended | none |
| grace period ended, that monthly payment paid in full | none |
| grace period ended, part still unpaid, no late fee yet for that due date | one late fee, at the amount this schedule sets |
| a late fee already charged for that due date | no further late fee for it |

## Booking tool: `assess_late_fee_02ab9d3a`

**What it does.** Books one late-fee entry on the plan's ledger, dated today and tied to the monthly due date it is charged for, and raises the plan balance by the fee. The patient sees the late fee on the plan's ledger and in the higher balance.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `assess_late_fee_02ab9d3a` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `pos_plan_id` — reference number of the PracticePay plan the fee is charged to, as returned by the PracticePay plan lookup. Identifier.
- `installment_due_date` — the monthly due date the late fee is charged for, written YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date with no time or time zone.
- `fee_amount` — the late fee in USD, 2 decimal places, a positive amount; stored rounded to the cent.

**Return.** A dictionary rendered as text with `pos_txn_id` (reference number of the new late-fee entry), `pos_plan_id` (the plan charged), `installment_due_date` (the due date the fee is for, YYYY-MM-DD), `fee_amount` (the fee booked, USD with 2 decimal places), `assessed_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `plan_balance` (the plan balance including the fee, USD with 2 decimal places). A `pos_txn_id` in the receipt means the late fee is booked.
